I've been wearing glasses since I've been 3. It's so easy you'll kick yourself. Here's the secret to pain free headphones:

1) take headphones and glasses off

2) put heaphones on

3) put glasses on, but let the arms of the glasses rest higher on the tops of the headphones themselves.

The idea is that the arms of the glasses should not go behind your ears as the pain is caused by the ear, arm, head sandwich.
